Name: Ceaseless Assault
Description: Increases Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 10% for 10 minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Name: Keep Guardian
Description: Increases Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 193 while near a keep.

Name: Hale Reserve
Description: Gain 45 Health Recovery for every 10 Ultimate you have.

Name: Cognitive Reserve
Description: Gain 10 Magicka Recovery for every 10 Ultimate you have.

Name: Athletic Reserve
Description: Gain 10 Stamina Recovery for every 10 Ultimate you have.

Name: Bolster Intellect
Description: Increases your Magicka Recovery by 258. Decreases your Stamina Recovery by 258.

Name: Bolster Endurance
Description: Increases your Stamina Recovery by 258. Decreases your Magicka Recovery by 258.

Name: Bolster Fortitude
Description: Increases your Health Recovery by 774.

Name: Bolster Magicka
Description: Increases your Max Magicka by 2192. Reduce your Max Stamina by 2192.

Name: Bolster Stamina
Description: Increases your Max Stamina by 2192. Reduces your Max Magicka by 2192.

Name: Combat Adept
Description: Reduces all costs by 5%.

Name: Spell Adept
Description: Reduces Magicka cost of abilities by 10%. Increases Stamina cost of abilities by 10%.

Name: Feat Adept
Description: Reduces Stamina cost of abilities by 10%. Increases Magicka cost of abilities by 10%.

Name: Class Adept
Description: Reduces the cost of your Class abilities by 10%. Increases the cost of your non-Class abilities by 10%.

Name: Weapon Adept
Description: Reduces the cost of your weapon abilities by 10%. Increases the cost of your non-weapon abilities by 10%.

Name: Tireless Guardian
Description: You stand as firm against a combatant's attacks as a Dwarven construct. Reduces the cost of Block by 20%.

Name: Tumbling
Description: Thanks to your alliance drill sergeants, you learned how to fall early in your training. Reduces the cost of Roll Dodge by 20%.

Name: Hardened
Description: You remain as focused on your goal as an ancient Dragon. Increase the duration of Crowd Control Immunity by 3 seconds.

Name: Alchemical Acceleration
Description: Due to steady potion use, your constitution allows you to imbibe alchemical concoctions safely at a greater frequency. Reduces your potion cooldown by 8 seconds.

Name: Freedom of Movement
Description: When you gain Crowd Control Immunity, you are as hard to entrap as a Dagi avoiding the Hungry Cat's claws. You become immune to snares and immobilizations that can be cleansed for 7 seconds. This can occur once every 8 seconds.

Name: Refreshing Stride
Description: Maneuvering quickly in and out of combat in Cyrodiil's killing fields recharges you. While Sprinting, you gain 387 Health and Magicka Recovery.

Name: Ultimate Adept
Description: The ease with which you perform your most challenging combat maneuver would make Pelinal smile. Reduces the cost of your Ultimate abilities by 20%.
